description: Install dependencies and verify baseline project health. Ensure all existing JS files parse without errors.
steps: Run npm install in /projects/sandbox/auto-cuan to install @google/generative-ai and @supabase/supabase-js
Run node -c on every file in api/*.js and assets/*.js to confirm no syntax errors
Count files in api/ directory to confirm exactly 10 files exist
Verify index.html exists and contains valid HTML structure
acceptance_criteria: All .js files in api/ and assets/ pass node -c syntax check
verification: for f in api/*.js assets/*.js; do node -c "$f" && echo "OK: $f"; done
findings: NODE_OPTIONS env var references a missing module (/opt/amazon/kiro-agent/proxy-bootstrap.js). Must unset NODE_OPTIONS before running npm or node commands. All 10 api/ files and 1 assets/ .js file pass syntax check. npm install adds 10 packages with 0 vulnerabilities.
